story: The author consults for small clinics. One clinic manager they work with keeps asking for a new booking tool, and each tool they try is abandoned within a month. The manager wants to get to a week where no patient is double-booked. The author has watched three tools fail the same way and does not yet know why.
want_sentence: The manager wants to get to a week where no patient is double-booked.

claims.label: local
claims.point: What blocks this clinic from ending double-bookings is that two receptionists keep separate paper lists, not the booking tool.
claims.anti_point: What blocks this clinic from ending double-bookings is that every tool they tried was too slow to use while a patient waits at the desk.

claims.label: portable
claims.point: A shared schedule fails when the people who fill it keep a private copy they trust more.
claims.anti_point: A shared schedule fails when entering a booking takes longer than the conversation that produced it.

claims.label: portable
claims.blank_reason: The author's history records no idea about what would get past the private-copy problem.
